metadata.build_description: GCC13 O3 LTO Q39 competitive baseline short=scaled vs independent cached short replacement; common Q39 stream/prefilter/FFT sources; separate ARDFTSRC reference; GCC13.3 -O3 -flto. Serial comparison with one warmup per implementation per case.
metadata.input_notes: The same manifest WAV is fed to every implementation. Hashes, rates, channels and loaded frame counts are checked. Logical duration comes from manifest logical_input_frames. The generator adds a common zero block to drain reference overlap; custom manifests must account for this.
metadata.timing_notes: Process CPU time; WAV IO/load, source format conversion, symbol loading and output validation excluded. Setup reported separately. Processing includes result collection and FAAR flushing; reference overlap drains via common zero input. ARDFTSRC output remains double internally until excluded WAV saving; FAAR public output float32.
metadata.memory_notes: Peak RSS includes entire input/output and IO-library buffers, not isolated streaming state. FAAR create_heap delta is net glibc live heap across create only.
